description: Executable specification fixtures for HCL expression evaluation, functions, unknown identity, and IAM policy condition semantics

cases.name: evaluate: templates, single interpolation, configured arguments, for expressions, conditionals, functions, try, and splat
format() follows Go fmt (round 12 codex) and chunklist / range / set / regexall / formatlist semantics

head.r/main.tf:
terraform {
  backend "s3" {}
}
variable "c" {}
resource "terraform_data" "out" {
  input = {
    f01 = format("logs-%03d", 1)
    f02 = format("logs-%04d", 1)
    f03 = format("[%-5s]", "ab")
    f04 = format("[%5s]", "ab")
    f05 = format("%5.2f", 3.14159)
    f06 = format("%x", 255)
    f07 = format("%X", 255)
    f08 = format("%o", 8)
    f09 = format("%b", 5)
    f10 = format("%+d", 5)
    f11 = format("% d", 5)
    f12 = format("%t", true)
    f13 = format("%q", "a")
    f14 = format("%.2s", "abcdef")
    f15 = format("%#x", 255)
    f16 = format("%e", 1234.5678)
    f17 = format("%d%%", 50)
    f18 = format("%-4d|", 7)
    eq_diff_known = ({ cidr = var.c, a = 1 } == { cidr = "x", a = 2 })
    eq_diff_len   = ([var.c] == [var.c, "a"])
    eq_known_t    = ({ a = [1, 2] } == { a = [1, 2] })
    eq_known_f    = (["a"] == ["b"])
    chunk_zero    = chunklist([1, 2, 3], 0)
    chunk_empty   = chunklist([], 2)
    chunk_two     = chunklist([1, 2, 3], 2)
    chunk_neg     = try(chunklist([1], -1), "err")
    chunk_frac    = try(chunklist([1], 1.5), "err")
    range_zero    = try(range(2, 0, 0), "err")
    range_huge    = try(range(0, 100000), "err")
    range_down    = range(4, 1)
    range_empty   = try(range(1, 4, -1), "err")
    range_step    = range(10, 5, -2)
    set_eq        = (toset(["a", "b"]) == setunion(["b"], ["a"]))
    set_ne        = (toset(["a", "b"]) != toset(["b", "c"]))
    re_named      = regexall("(?P<name>[a-z]+)", "old")[0].name
    fmtlist_empty = formatlist("arn:aws:s3:::%s/*", [])
    fmtlist_pairs = formatlist("%s-%s", ["a", "b"], ["x", "y"])
  }
}

cases.name: unknown identity: an object with an unknown key keeps its values in its identity, and references to different resources differ
partially known resources in IAM identity policies (src/policy/iam.test.ts)
trust policy conditions and resource policy narrowing operators (unknownBlocks, round6, round6codex, round7)
